name: monday
description: Access monday.com boards, items, groups, columns, updates, users, and WorkForms via monday's hosted OAuth MCP server. Browser OAuth, no API keys.

connection.instructions:
monday.com requires an OAuth app. Create one at *apps.monday.com → Build → Create app*:

1. Under **OAuth**, set the **Redirect URL** to the value shown above
2. Add scopes: `me:read`, `boards:read`, `workspaces:read`, `users:read`
3. Copy the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** below.

When you click Connect you'll sign in to monday.com and authorise read access.
